original:
Let $B$ be an unbalanced block with $m$ vertices whose negative edges are
incident to a common vertex $u$ . Then

 $Z_{B}(1)=(-1)^{m+1}\beta(H_{u}(B))\quad\text{and}\quad\beta(H_{u}(B))\geq 1.$
type: ∀ (V : Type u_1) [inst : Finite V] (P N : SimpleGraph V) (u : V), Mathlib2.x2611_16458_isBlock (P ⊔ N) Set.univ → ¬Mathlib2.x2611_16458_balanced P N → (∀ (v w : V), N.Adj v w → v = u ∨ w = u) → Polynomial.eval 1 (Mathlib2.x2611_16458_zeroFree P N) = (-1) ^ (Nat.card V + 1) * Mathlib2.x2611_16458_beta (Mathlib2.x2611_16458_split P N u) ∧ 1 ≤ Mathlib2.x2611_16458_beta (Mathlib2.x2611_16458_split P N u)

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux1 {V : Type*} [Finite V] (u : V) :
    Nat.card (Bool ⊕ {v : V // v ≠ u}) = Nat.card V + 1 := by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite V
  rw [Nat.card_sum]
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_bool]
  have h : Fintype.card {v : V // v ≠ u} + 1 = Fintype.card V := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_unique]
    have hp : 0 < Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨u⟩
    omega
  omega

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux2 (p q : Polynomial ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (h : q = (Polynomial.X - 1) * p) :
    p.eval 1 = (-1 : ℤ) ^ n * ((-1 : ℤ) ^ n * q.derivative.eval 1) := by
  subst q
  simp only [Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.derivative_sub,
    Polynomial.derivative_X, Polynomial.derivative_one, sub_zero,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_one,
    Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X, sub_self, zero_mul, add_zero, one_mul]
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
  simp [← two_mul, pow_mul]

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux3 {V W : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (f : V → W) (hedge : ∀ v w, G.Adj v w → H.Reachable (f v) (f w))
    {v w : V} (h : G.Reachable v w) : H.Reachable (f v) (f w) := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := h
  induction p with
  | nil => exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl
  | cons ha p ih => exact (hedge _ _ ha).trans ih

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux4 {V W : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (f : V → W) (hG : G.Connected)
    (hedge : ∀ v w, G.Adj v w → H.Reachable (f v) (f w))
    (hcover : ∀ w, ∃ v, H.Reachable w (f v)) : H.Connected := by
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := hG.nonempty
  letI : Nonempty W := ⟨f v⟩
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro a b
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hcover a
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hcover b
  exact hx.trans ((x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux3 f hedge (hG x y)).trans hy.symm)

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux5 {V : Type*} (P N : SimpleGraph V) (u : V)
    (hunbal : ¬ x2611_16458_balanced P N)
    (hneg : ∀ v w, N.Adj v w → v = u ∨ w = u) :
    (∃ w, P.Adj u w) ∧ (∃ w, N.Adj u w) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · by_contra! hp
    apply hunbal
    refine ⟨fun v => decide (v = u), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro v w hvw
      have hv : v ≠ u := by rintro rfl; exact hp w hvw
      have hw : w ≠ u := by rintro rfl; exact hp v hvw.symm
      simp [hv, hw]
    · intro v w hvw
      obtain rfl | rfl := hneg v w hvw
      · simp [hvw.ne.symm]
      · simp [hvw.ne]
  · by_contra! hn
    apply hunbal
    refine ⟨fun _ => false, fun _ _ _ => rfl, ?_⟩
    intro v w hvw
    obtain rfl | rfl := hneg v w hvw
    · exact (hn w hvw).elim
    · exact (hn v hvw.symm).elim

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux6 {V : Type*} (P N : SimpleGraph V) (u : V)
    (hneg : ∀ v w, N.Adj v w → v = u ∨ w = u)
    (hconn : ((P ⊔ N).induce {v : V | v ≠ u}).Connected) :
    (P.induce {v : V | v ≠ u}).Connected := by
  apply hconn.mono
  intro v w h
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact ((hneg v w h).elim v.property w.property).elim

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux7 {V : Type*} (P N : SimpleGraph V) (u : V)
    (hcore : (P.induce {v : V | v ≠ u}).Connected)
    (hp : ∃ w, P.Adj u w) (hn : ∃ w, N.Adj u w) (s : Bool) :
    ((x2611_16458_split P N u).induce {a | a ≠ Sum.inl s}).Connected := by
  classical
  let f : {v : V // v ≠ u} → {a : Bool ⊕ {v : V // v ≠ u} // a ≠ Sum.inl s} :=
    fun v => ⟨Sum.inr v, by simp⟩
  apply x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux4 f hcore
  · intro v w h
    apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
    change (x2611_16458_split P N u).Adj (Sum.inr v) (Sum.inr w)
    exact ⟨fun he => h.ne (Sum.inr.inj he), Or.inl h⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    cases a with
    | inr w => exact ⟨w, SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl⟩
    | inl t =>
      cases t with
      | false =>
        obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hn
        refine ⟨⟨w, hw.ne.symm⟩, SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ?_⟩
        change (x2611_16458_split P N u).Adj (Sum.inl false) (Sum.inr _)
        simpa [x2611_16458_split] using hw
      | true =>
        obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hp
        refine ⟨⟨w, hw.ne.symm⟩, SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ?_⟩
        change (x2611_16458_split P N u).Adj (Sum.inl true) (Sum.inr _)
        simpa [x2611_16458_split] using hw

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux8 {V : Type*} (P N : SimpleGraph V) (u v : V)
    (hv : v ≠ u) (hneg : ∀ a b, N.Adj a b → a = u ∨ b = u)
    (hconn : ((P ⊔ N).induce {x : V | x ≠ v}).Connected) :
    ((x2611_16458_split P N u).induce {a | a ≠ Sum.inr ⟨v, hv⟩}).Connected := by
  classical
  let T := {a : Bool ⊕ {x : V // x ≠ u} // a ≠ Sum.inr ⟨v, hv⟩}
  let H := (x2611_16458_split P N u).induce {a | a ≠ Sum.inr ⟨v, hv⟩}
  let ct : T := ⟨Sum.inl true, by simp⟩
  let cf : T := ⟨Sum.inl false, by simp⟩
  let f : {x : V // x ≠ v} → T := fun x =>
    if hx : x.val = u then ct else
      ⟨Sum.inr ⟨x.val, hx⟩, by simpa using x.property⟩
  have htc : H.Adj ct cf := by simp [H, ct, cf, x2611_16458_split]
  have hstar (x : V) (hxv : x ≠ v) (hxu : x ≠ u) (he : (P ⊔ N).Adj u x) :
      H.Reachable ct ⟨Sum.inr ⟨x, hxu⟩, by simpa using hxv⟩ := by
    rcases he with he | he
    · apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
      simpa [H, ct, x2611_16458_split] using he
    · apply htc.reachable.trans
      apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
      simpa [H, cf, x2611_16458_split] using he
  apply x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux4 f hconn
  · intro a b hab
    by_cases ha : a.val = u
    · have hb : b.val ≠ u := by
        intro hb
        exact hab.ne (Subtype.ext (ha.trans hb.symm))
      simpa only [f, dif_pos ha, dif_neg hb] using
        hstar b.val b.property hb (by simpa only [SimpleGraph.induce_adj, ha] using hab)
    · by_cases hb : b.val = u
      · simpa only [f, dif_pos hb, dif_neg ha] using
          (hstar a.val a.property ha (by
            simpa only [SimpleGraph.induce_adj, hb] using hab.symm)).symm
      · apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
        simp only [f, dif_neg ha, dif_neg hb]
        change (x2611_16458_split P N u).Adj (Sum.inr _) (Sum.inr _)
        rcases hab with hab | hab
        · refine ⟨?_, Or.inl hab⟩
          intro he
          apply hab.ne
          exact congrArg (fun x : {x : V // x ≠ u} => x.val) (Sum.inr.inj he)
        · exact ((hneg a b hab).elim ha hb).elim
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    cases a with
    | inl s =>
      refine ⟨⟨u, hv.symm⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [f, dif_pos rfl]
      cases s with
      | false => exact htc.symm.reachable
      | true => exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl
    | inr w =>
      have hw : w.val ≠ v := by
        intro he
        apply ha
        exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext he)
      refine ⟨⟨w.val, hw⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [f, dif_neg w.property]
      exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux9 {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (v : V)
    (h : (G.induce {x | x ≠ v}).Connected) (hn : ∃ w, G.Adj v w) : G.Connected := by
  classical
  apply x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux4 (fun x : {x // x ≠ v} => x.val) h
  · intro a b hab
    exact hab.reachable.map (SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce _).toHom
  · intro a
    by_cases ha : a = v
    · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hn
      exact ⟨⟨w, hw.ne.symm⟩, ha.symm ▸ hw.reachable⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl⟩

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux10 {V : Type*} [Finite V]
    (P N : SimpleGraph V) (u : V)
    (hblock : x2611_16458_isBlock (P ⊔ N) Set.univ)
    (hunbal : ¬ x2611_16458_balanced P N)
    (hneg : ∀ v w, N.Adj v w → v = u ∨ w = u) :
    x2611_16458_twoConnected (x2611_16458_split P N u) := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hn⟩ := x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux5 P N u hunbal hneg
  have hdelete (v : V) : ((P ⊔ N).induce {w : V | w ≠ v}).Connected := by
    have hs : (Set.univ \ {v} : Set V) = {w : V | w ≠ v} := by ext w; simp
    rw [← hs]
    exact hblock.2.2.1 v (Set.mem_univ v)
  have hcore := x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux6 P N u hneg (hdelete u)
  have hclone := x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux7 P N u hcore hp hn
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨v, -, w, -, hvw⟩ := hblock.1
    letI : Nontrivial V := ⟨⟨v, w, hvw.ne⟩⟩
    rw [x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux1]
    have hcard := Finite.one_lt_card (α := V)
    omega
  · apply x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux9 _ (Sum.inl false) (hclone false)
    refine ⟨Sum.inl true, ?_⟩
    simp [x2611_16458_split]
  · intro a
    cases a with
    | inl s => exact hclone s
    | inr v => exact x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux8 P N u v.val v.property hneg (hdelete v)

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux11 {V : Type*} [Finite V]
    (P N : SimpleGraph V) (u : V)
    (hneg : ∀ v w, N.Adj v w → v = u ∨ w = u) :
    x2611_16458_zeroFree (x2611_16458_split P N u) ⊥ =
      (Polynomial.X - 1) * x2611_16458_zeroFree P N := by
  sorry

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux12 {V : Type*} [Finite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : x2611_16458_twoConnected G) :
    1 ≤ x2611_16458_beta G := by
  sorry

theorem x2611_16458_cor2_5 (V : Type*) [Finite V] (P N : SimpleGraph V) (u : V)
    (hblock : x2611_16458_isBlock (P ⊔ N) Set.univ)
    (hunbal : ¬ x2611_16458_balanced P N)
    (hneg : ∀ v w, N.Adj v w → v = u ∨ w = u) :
    (x2611_16458_zeroFree P N).eval 1 =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (Nat.card V + 1) * x2611_16458_beta (x2611_16458_split P N u) ∧
    1 ≤ x2611_16458_beta (x2611_16458_split P N u) := by
  have hpoly := x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux11 P N u hneg
  have htwo := x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux10 P N u hblock hunbal hneg
  refine ⟨?_, x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux12 (x2611_16458_split P N u) htwo⟩
  have hh := x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux2 (x2611_16458_zeroFree P N)
    (x2611_16458_zeroFree (x2611_16458_split P N u) ⊥) (Nat.card V + 1) hpoly
  simpa only [x2611_16458_beta, x2611_16458_cor2_5_aux1] using hh
